features.note: Facade and lobby tiers read. Corridor and auditorium do not: in lights-on-corridor the wall planes, doors and carpet sit at essentially zero luminance (only exit signs, four warm ceiling pools, posters and the green floor markers are above black), and in lights-on-sala-3 / reference-match the room interior is a black void. The four-tier ladder collapses into two lit tiers plus two black tiers, so the corridor→auditorium half of the plan grammar is not readable from the required presets.

lights-on-sala-3 and reference-match show NO stepped seating silhouette whatsoever. The blue aisle-edge strips, two orange center lines, the screen rectangle and three soft ceiling wash pools float in pure black; the seat/step mass, rake, cross-aisle and side walls receive zero fill, and no in-room exit sign is visible. The pass expectation ('low-level aisle/exit/screen light reveals silhouettes') is unmet: the room reads as a black hole, not a dim auditorium.

The strongest view. lights-on-lobby has real fixture light: emissive ceiling panels with a visible falloff gradient down the tile, specular glints in the gloss floor, red DRINKS/menu bands and kiosk screens sitting clearly above the wall value, and the counter mass legible. The marquee, Cinemex sign and poster bank stay focal on facade/grazing, and the checkpoint/back-of-lobby wall is not clipped out.

eng-complete-network exposes every endpoint group without occlusion: four green solid RS-485 trunks with their drops are traceable end-to-end, LoRaWAN reads as blue dashed, the Ethernet chain reads as blue solid out to ROUTER/FIREWALL → INTERNET → NIAGARA → PC/TABLET/SMARTPHONE, and the schematic board is legible. TC300-01…13, UC-A/UC-C and BUS labels stay readable as light chips on dark backgrounds. eng-neutral is dimmer and the interior floor is a murky near-black red, which costs some points, but the media and endpoints still separate.

Neutral and grazing remain legible in the architecture state, and the engineering captures remain legible in theirs. But reference-match — one of the three mandated look-dev framings — is effectively illegible: the intended stepped-seating reference read is replaced by black, with only LED strips and the screen visible. One of the four named captures fails its intended state.

important_features.note: The 1.8 m figure at the entrance reads correctly against the door bank and marquee in facade/grazing; devices are not inflated and are surfaced by label chips and highlights in the engineering captures rather than by false scale.

The four-tier ladder does not read. Tier 1 (exterior/facade) and tier 2 (lobby) are convincing and correctly ordered, with the red commercial accents above the wall value. Tier 3 (corridor) is not 'dim but legible' — it is crushed to near-black; the same wall/floor surfaces that read in the lobby carry no value at all here. Tier 4 (auditorium) is not 'low-emission but readable' — it is black with floating emissives. Corridor and auditorium are effectively the same luminance, so the ladder has two steps, not four. The lights-on/off pairs DO prove real per-channel emission (ceiling panels, kiosk/menu screens, corridor strips and floor markers, aisle LEDs and the sala ceiling wash all switch, and it is not a global exposure change), but the marquee/Cinemex sign and the red canopy do not change at all between light_state=on and off, so the exterior channel is barely a channel.
In the engineering captures the RS-485 trunks stay on their trays/routes and land on device markers; nothing floats free of containment, and the lighting has not broken this read.

defects: lights-on-corridor: the corridor is not dim, it is black. The side walls, doors, room-number plates and carpet all sit at effectively zero luminance; the only pixels above black are four small warm ceiling pools, the EXIT signs, two poster panels and the green floor route markers. Nothing establishes a corridor VALUE between the lobby and the auditorium.

lights-on-sala-3 and lights-on-reference-match: the auditorium is a black hole. No stepped seat block, no rake, no side wall, no cross-aisle silhouette is carved out. The blue aisle strips, orange center lines, the screen and three ceiling wash pools read as disconnected emissive shapes hanging in void, with no surface for them to spill onto.
No in-room exit sign is visible in either sala-3 capture, although the corridor proves emissive exit signs exist elsewhere in the scene.

lights-off pairs prove a real per-channel change for the interior (ceiling panels, kiosk/menu screens, corridor ceiling strips and floor markers, aisle LEDs, sala ceiling wash all go dark) — but the exterior channel does not: the red marquee canopy and the 'Cinemex' sign render at identical brightness in lights-on and lights-off. Only the small under-canopy downlight strips switch off. The marquee is the one thing that should visibly go dark.

facade: the composition is a thin band. The building occupies roughly the middle 20% of the frame height, squeezed between a large pure-black void above the roofline and an equally large flat, featureless gray plaza below. No exterior fixture pools, no marquee spill on the ground, no gradient in the plaza.

grazing: the low-angle pass exposes smooth-plastic response. The forecourt is one flat gradient with no falloff and no light pool; the red marquee is a uniform saturated slab with a single specular edge strip; the white facade panels have no shading break across their length. There is nothing in the elevation for the grazing light to reveal.
lobby: the ceiling plane itself is pure black between the emissive panels, so the panels read as slabs floating in a void rather than as fixtures recessed into a ceiling.

corridor: a mid-gray rectangle at the end of the corridor (the far wall / screen-wall plane) renders at a flat, essentially unlit value that is far brighter than every surface around it, breaking the corridor's value structure.

eng-neutral: the engineering state is very dark — the interior floors read as murky near-black red and small device markers are hard to separate from the shell. The spec's engineering note calls for the neutral fill to be RAISED in this state; it has not been.
corrections: Raise the corridor to a real, distinct tier. Give the corridor walls, doors and carpet enough ambient/bounce (or add low-intensity warm wall-wash strips with visible falloff on the wall plane) that the same surfaces which read in the lobby still read here at a clearly lower — but non-zero — value. Target: corridor wall value clearly below lobby wall value and clearly above auditorium wall value.

Light the auditorium so the seat blocks are carved out, not erased. Add a very low neutral ambient/hemisphere term plus screen bounce so the stepped seating mass, the rake, the side walls and the cross-aisle silhouette are visible against the darkness; the blue aisle LEDs must spill onto the step nosings and carpet instead of floating as unlit strips.
Add emissive exit signs inside the auditoriums and frame them into the sala-3 / reference-match preset so the aisle/exit/screen light triad is provable in the pixels.

Make the marquee a real emission channel: drive the red canopy and the Cinemex sign emissive from light_state so both visibly go dark in the lights-off capture, and add exterior fixture spill (a marquee/downlight pool on the forecourt) that also disappears with the lights.

Reframe the facade preset so the building fills the frame: lower the camera target onto the entrance band, tighten the FOV or move in, and crop the dead black sky and the empty plaza. Add value structure to the forecourt (light pools, a gradient) so the ground is not a flat gray field.

Fix the grazing read: introduce highlight falloff across the facade elevation — a graded key across the white panels, varied specular response on the red marquee, and a visible pool where the entrance light hits the ground — so the low angle reveals form instead of one flat gradient.
Give the lobby ceiling a lit surface value so the emissive panels sit in a ceiling rather than in black.
Correct the unlit-looking mid-gray plane at the end of the corridor so it takes the same lighting as the surfaces around it.
Raise the neutral fill in the engineering state (per lighting_notes.engineering) so device markers and interior floors separate from the shell in eng-neutral, without letting the network media bloom.
Re-capture the full lights-on / lights-off / eng set for all eight views after these changes; the pair evidence is otherwise sound and does not need to be restructured.
